title: A Simulation-Grounded Agentic VLM Framework for Wildfire Monitoring and Reporting
title_zh: 一种基于模拟的智能体视觉语言模型框架：用于野火监测与报告

paragraphs.en: Effective wildfire monitoring requires relating visual evidence to physical fire dynamics, yet real videos with synchronized physical annotations are scarce and high-fidelity 3D simulation is costly. We present a simulation-grounded vision-language model (VLM) framework that automatically converts 2D wildfire simulations into labeled video episodes. A fixed Blender mapping produces low-detail 3D proxies aligned with simulator terrain, fuel layout, fire activity, and wind cues; controllable video generation supplies richer appearance. The proxies are intermediate representations rather than finely rendered final scenes. Generated videos and simulator labels form reusable multimodal memory for a training-free multi-agent VLM system that retrieves reference episodes, reconciles visual and memory-based predictions, and produces structured wildfire reports. On held-out generated episodes, video memory achieves 51.5 % 51.5\% exact four-tag accuracy, compared with 22.6 % 22.6\% for direct VLM querying and 16 16 – 17 % 17\% for text-only memory; the complete system achieves 77.3 % 77.3\% accuracy on six simulator-derived report fields. Component ablations, cross-generator tests, and three real-UAV evaluations assess retrieval, reporting, generator changes, and observable monitoring tasks. The framework connects automatic simulation-to-proxy conversion with memory-based VLM reasoning under scarce real-world physical annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 有效的野火监测需要将视觉证据与物理火灾动态联系起来，但带有同步物理标注的真实视频十分稀缺，而高保真度的三维模拟成本高昂。 我们提出了一种基于模拟的视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架，该框架可自动将二维野火模拟转换为带标签的视频片段。 固定的 Blender 映射可生成与模拟器地形、燃料布局、火灾活动和风力线索对齐的低细节三维代理；可控的视频生成则提供了更丰富的外观表现。 这些代理是中间表示，而非精细渲染的最终场景。 生成的视频和模拟器标签共同构成了可重复使用的多模态记忆，用于一个无需训练的多人智能体 VLM 系统，该系统能够检索参考片段、协调视觉预测与基于记忆的预测，并生成结构化的野火报告。 在预留的生成片段上，视频记忆实现了 51.5% 的精确四标签准确率，而直接查询 VLM 的准确率为 22.6%，仅使用文本记忆则仅为 16%–17%；完整系统在六个源自模拟器的报告字段上达到了 77.3% 的准确率。 组件消融分析、跨生成器测试以及三次真实无人机评估，共同检验了检索能力、报告生成、生成器变更以及可观测的监测任务表现。 该框架将自动的模拟到代理的转换与基于记忆的多智能体 VLM 推理相结合，即便在真实世界物理标注稀缺的情况下也能有效运行。

paragraphs.en: Wildfire monitoring and reporting are fundamentally about connecting what is seen to what is happening physically in the wildland. Fire-spread simulators (e.g., Mandel et al. (2011) ; Finney (1998) ; Mallet et al. (2009) ; Doyle et al. (2024) ) encode how fuel, slope, moisture, and wind shape propagation, and satellite, aerial, and UAV measurements provide partial visual observations of active incidents. Modern vision-language models (VLMs) need a framework to align two forms of evidence in a shared representation. Real wildfire videos are visually rich, yet labels for wind, moisture, slope, fuel condition, burn extent, and severe-fire behavior are usually absent. Simulators expose these variables directly, yet their native outputs are grid states, masks, and fire fronts, which differ from the aerial-view videos that VLMs are expected to interpret.
paragraphs.zh: 野火监测与报告本质上是将所见之物与野外实际发生的情况联系起来。 火蔓延模拟器（例如 Mandel 等人 (2011)；Finney (1998)；Mallet 等人 (2009)；Doyle 等人 (2024)）编码了燃料、坡度、湿度和风力如何影响火势传播，而卫星、航空和无人机测量则提供了对活跃火情的部分视觉观测信息。 现代视觉语言模型（VLM）需要一个框架，将两种形式的证据对齐到共享的表示中。 真实的野火视频在视觉上非常丰富，但其中通常缺少关于风力、湿度、坡度、燃料状况、燃烧范围和严重火行为等的标签。 模拟器可以直接暴露这些变量，但其原始输出是网格状态、掩码和火线，这与 VLM 需要解读的航空视角视频有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Though existing wildfire VLM work has advanced fire and smoke recognition, UAV monitoring, satellite risk analysis, and VLM-guided planning Du et al. (2025) ; Wu et al. (2025) ; Seidel et al. (2025) ; Ayanzadeh et al. (2026) ; Webb et al. (2026) ; Xie et al. (2025) ; Sandeep et al. (2026) , temporally rich videos paired with physical fire-state labels remain scarce. Collecting synchronized wind, moisture, slope, fuel, and fire-behavior annotations is hazardous, expensive, and hard to control. Available UAV datasets provide valuable detection and segmentation annotations Shamsoshoara et al. (2021) ; Kularatne et al. (2024) ; Pesonen et al. (2025) , but the annotations used here do not jointly describe these drivers. Fire-spread simulators expose such conditions without providing camera-view observations, while full 3D fire simulation Kokosza et al. (2024) ; Hädrich et al. (2021) incurs costs that limit coverage across fuels, terrains, weather, and cameras. We therefore study a scalable middle ground: efficient 2D simulations over real terrain and fuel maps are automatically lifted into lightweight Blender proxies, translated into controlled videos, and stored as physics-labeled memory for VLM reasoning.

paragraphs.en: Recent developments such as Code World Model ( Chen et al., 2026b ) and Blender scene authoring with GPT-6 Astra highlight the potential of executable representations for visual world construction. We explore this direction in a simulation-grounded VLM framework for wildfire monitoring and reporting (Figure 1 ). Each episode starts with a 2D simulation over real LANDFIRE terrain and fuel data spanning approximately 3 ​ km 3\,\mathrm{km} . A fully automatic Blender procedure maps evolving simulator fields into terrain, vegetation, flame, and wind-driven smoke cues. This lightweight proxy is an intermediate representation : fixed conversion rules maintain simulator-to-scene correspondence, while depth, scribble, and prompt controls guide richer video appearance. Generated clips retain their prompts, simulator parameters, environmental tags, and fire-behavior labels as reusable multimodal memory. Retrieved episodes then complement direct visual reasoning for interpreting new wildfire videos without updating VLM weights. Section 6 further discusses the connections to code-based world construction and general-purpose scene authoring.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的发展，例如 Code World Model（Chen 等人，2026b）以及使用 GPT-6 Astra 进行 Blender 场景创作，凸显了可执行表示在构建视觉世界方面的潜力。 我们在一个以模拟为基础、用于野火监测与报告的 VLM 框架中探索了这一方向（图 1）。 每个回合都以基于真实 LANDFIRE 地形和燃料数据的二维模拟开始，覆盖范围约为 3 ​ km 3\,\mathrm{km}。 一个完全自动化的 Blender 流程将不断演变的模拟器字段映射为地形、植被、火焰和风驱动烟雾的提示线索。 这种轻量级代理是一种中间表示：固定的转换规则保持了模拟器与场景之间的对应关系，而深度、草图和提示控制则引导出更丰富的视频外观。 生成的片段保留了其提示、模拟器参数、环境标签和火行为标签，作为可重用的多模态记忆。 随后检索到的回合可为解释新的野火视频提供补充，无需更新 VLM 的权重即可实现直接视觉推理。 第 6 节进一步讨论了其与基于代码的世界构建及通用场景创作之间的联系。

paragraphs.en: Generated videos with known simulator labels provide controlled evaluation targets. We use 500 geo-disjoint locations: 400 episodes populate memory and 100 are held out for evaluation (Appendix A ). For each query, retrieved references complement direct visual reasoning, and a judge resolves reporter disagreements. Video memory achieves 51.5% exact four-tag accuracy versus 16–17% for text-only memory and 22.6% for direct VLM querying; reporting reaches 77.3% on six simulator-derived fields. Structured records retain predictions, evidence, and reasoning. Cross-generator and real-UAV tests additionally assess generator changes, smoke/fire detection, and visible fire-area assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 带有已知模拟器标签的生成视频提供了受控的评估目标。 我们使用了 500 个地理上互不重叠的位置：其中 400 个回合用于填充记忆，另外 100 个则保留用于评估（附录 A）。 对于每个查询，检索到的参考信息可补充直接的视觉推理，并由一个评判者解决报告员之间的分歧。 视频记忆的精确四标签准确率达到了 51.5%，而仅使用文本的记忆准确率为 16–17%，直接通过 VLM 查询的准确率为 22.6%；在六个源自模拟器的字段上，报告准确率达到了 77.3%。 结构化记录保留了预测、证据和推理过程。 跨生成器和真实无人机测试还进一步评估了生成器的变化、烟雾/火焰检测以及可见火区评估。

paragraphs.en: Automatic simulation-grounded visual evidence. We connect efficient 2D wildfire simulation to controllable video generation through a fully automatic Blender proxy. A fixed mapping expresses terrain, fuel layout, fire activity, and wind cues as lightweight 3D controls, constructing labeled visual episodes under scarce real-world physical annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 基于自动模拟的视觉证据。 我们通过一个全自动的 Blender 代理，将高效的二维野火模拟与可控的视频生成连接起来。 一种固定的映射方式将地形、燃料布局、火情活动和风力提示表示为轻量级的 3D 控制参数，从而在缺乏真实世界物理标注的情况下构建带标签的视觉片段。

paragraphs.en: Memory-augmented agentic reporting. We organize generated videos and simulator context as reusable multimodal memory, and combine retrieval and reranking with complementary VLM reporters and selective disagreement adjudication. The training-free system produces environmental-driver estimates and structured wildfire reports without updating model weights.
paragraphs.zh: 增强记忆的智能体式报告。 我们将生成的视频和模拟器上下文组织为可重用的多模态记忆，并将检索与重新排序相结合，辅以互补的视觉语言模型报告器和选择性分歧裁决。 该无需训练的系统能够生成环境驱动因素估计值和结构化野火报告，而无需更新模型权重。

paragraphs.en: Controlled evaluation with complementary real-UAV tests. Video memory achieves 51.5% exact four-tag accuracy versus 22.6% for direct VLM querying and 16–17% for text-only memory; the full reporter reaches 77.3% on six simulator-derived fields. Ablations, cross-generator tests, and real-UAV perceptual evaluations examine the framework’s components and transfer beyond the primary generated-video setting.
paragraphs.zh: 通过互补的真实无人机测试进行受控评估。 视频记忆在精确四标签识别上的准确率达到 51.5%，而直接 VLM 查询仅为 22.6%，纯文本记忆则仅为 16–17%；完整报告器在六个源自模拟器的字段上达到了 77.3% 的准确率。 消融实验、跨生成器测试以及真实无人机感知评估，共同检验了该框架的各个组件及其在主要生成视频场景之外的迁移能力。

paragraphs.en: Wildfire prediction combines spread models with sensing. Rothermel Rothermel (1972) underlies FARSITE Finney (1998) ; level-set methods handle fire-front topology changes Mallet et al. (2009) ; WRF-SFIRE couples spread with atmospheric dynamics Mandel et al. (2011) . MODIS and VIIRS provide broad-area fire observations Justice et al. (2002) ; Giglio et al. (2016) ; Schroeder et al. (2014) , complemented by UAV smoke/fire detection and front tracking Bailon-Ruiz et al. (2022) ; Raoufi et al. (2025) ; Fan et al. (2025) . Rather than replacing simulators or sensors, we automatically translate simulator states into visual reference episodes for VLM monitoring and reporting.
paragraphs.zh: 野火预测结合了传播模型与感知技术。Rothermel（1972）的研究构成了FARSITE（Finney，1998）的基础；水平集方法用于处理火锋拓扑结构的变化（Mallet等，2009）；WRF-SFIRE则将火火传播与大气动力学耦合在一起（Mandel等，2011）。MODIS和VIIRS提供了大范围的火情观测数据（Justice等，2002；Giglio等，2016；Schroeder等，2014），并由无人机烟雾/火源探测及火锋追踪技术加以补充（Bailon-Ruiz等，2022；Raoufi等，2025；Fan等，2025）。我们并非要取代模拟器或传感器，而是将模拟器的状态自动转换为视觉参考片段，用于VLM的监测与报告。

paragraphs.en: Scientific VLM benchmarks show that general-purpose multimodal models can be useful but struggle with domain-specific visual structure, terminology, and evaluation protocols Esparza et al. (2025) ; Roberts et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2024b) ; Kuckreja et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2023) . Wildfire VLM systems have been studied for scene recognition Du et al. (2025) , smoke/fire detection Wu et al. (2025) ; Qi et al. (2026) , UAV situational awareness Seidel et al. (2025) , satellite-image risk reasoning Ayanzadeh et al. (2026) , and VLM-guided reinforcement learning in wildfire digital twins Webb et al. (2026) . These works motivate VLM-based decision support, but they also highlight the need for physically grounded video data and task-specific evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 科学性的VLM基准测试表明，通用多模态模型虽然可能有用，但在处理领域特定的视觉结构、术语和评估协议方面存在困难 Esparza等（2025）；Roberts等（2024）；Wu等 （2024b）；Kuckreja等（2024）；Li等（2023）。 野火VLM系统已在场景识别方面得到研究 Du等 （2025），烟雾/火焰检测 Wu等（2025）；Qi等 （2026），无人机态势感知 Seidel等 （2025），卫星图像风险推理 Ayanzadeh等 （2026），以及野火数字孪生中由VLM引导的强化学习 Webb等（2026）。 这些研究推动了基于VLM的决策支持，但也凸显了对具有物理依据的视频数据和特定任务评估的需求。

paragraphs.en: The first stage constructs labeled visual episodes to reduce reliance on scarce real footage with synchronized physical annotations. We retain the scalability and annotations of 2D wildfire simulation while making its outputs visually accessible to VLMs: diverse episodes over real terrain and fuel maps are lifted into procedural 3D proxies and translated into aerial-view clips. Here, simulation-grounded refers to the simulator-derived labels and controls linking each episode to its originating scenario; visual and temporal cue alignment is evaluated separately in Section 5.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段构建带标签的视觉片段，以减少对稀缺真实影像及其同步物理标注的依赖。 我们在保持二维野火模拟的可扩展性和标注能力的同时，使其输出对视觉语言模型（VLM）具备视觉可访问性：基于真实地形和燃料分布图生成的多样化片段被提升为程序化三维代理，并转换为俯视角度的视频片段。 此处，“基于模拟”指的是源自模拟器的标签和控制参数，它们将每个片段与其原始场景关联起来；视觉与时间线索的对齐则在第 5.1 节中单独进行评估。

paragraphs.en: To balance physical grounding and generation throughput, we use SimFire Doyle et al. (2024) as our 2D wildfire simulation platform. SimFire follows the classical Rothermel fire-spread model Rothermel (1972) detailed in Appendix B.1 , allowing us to generate large numbers of wildfire episodes with meaningful macroscopic spread behavior. For each episode, we randomly sample a geographic location specified by latitude and longitude, and query the LANDFIRE database to obtain real U.S. fuel and terrain information. Fuel types are represented using the Anderson 13 fuel model Anderson (1982) , while terrain elevation is used to derive slope and support later 3D proxy construction. Wind direction, wind-related parameters, and fuel-moisture settings are randomized to increase scenario diversity. Each simulation covers a region of approximately 3 ​ km 3\,\mathrm{km} in spatial extent. We refer readers to Appendix B and C for implementation details.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在物理模拟的可靠性和生成吞吐量之间取得平衡，我们使用 SimFire Doyle et al. (2024) 作为我们的二维野火模拟平台。 SimFire 遵循附录 B.1 中详述的经典 Rothermel 野火蔓延模型 Rothermel (1972)，使我们能够生成大量具有有意义宏观蔓延行为的野火事件。 对于每个事件，我们会随机采样由经纬度指定的地理位置，并查询 LANDFIRE 数据库以获取真实的美国燃料和地形信息。 燃料类型使用 Anderson 13 燃料模型 Anderson (1982) 来表示，而地形高程则用于推导坡度并为后续的三维代理构建提供支持。 风向、与风相关的参数以及燃料湿度设置均被随机化，以增加场景的多样性。 每次模拟覆盖的空间范围约为 3 ​ km 3\,\mathrm{km}。 有关实现细节，请读者参考附录 B 和 C。

paragraphs.en: Each episode is summarized using four physically meaningful factors: wind speed, moisture, slope angle, and vegetation density. Each factor is discretized into low and high levels, yielding a compact set of simulator-derived tags. These tags provide coarse environmental regimes for retrieval-based state estimation and agent reasoning, rather than continuous measurements of a query incident. Tag thresholds are specified in Appendix C ; the six downstream report-field definitions appear in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 1 , the 2D simulator produces fire masks, fuel maps, terrain fields, and fire-front states, but these outputs are simple 2D projections onto the terrain topography and therefore do not provide a 3D visual image similar to UAV video footage. Elevation is converted into a height-field terrain mesh; Anderson 13 fuel categories are mapped to procedural vegetation and terrain textures; burning cells are augmented with flame billboards; and smoke billboards are oriented and animated according to wind speed and direction. The proxy is not intended to be photorealistic. Its role is to encode simulator-derived spatial structure—terrain shape, vegetation distribution, active fire location, and wind-conditioned smoke direction—in a form that can guide video generation. For details of fuel models mapping with billboard assets, we refer readers to Appendix B.2 .

paragraphs.en: The proxy rendering encodes simulator structure but remains visually simple. We use controllable video generation to translate it into a visually richer wildfire clip. Following VACE Jiang et al. (2025) , the generator is conditioned on a depth sequence Ranftl et al. (2020) ; Yang et al. (2024) , a scribble sequence Chan et al. (2022) , and a text prompt. The depth and scribble controls guide geometry, vegetation layout, fire-front location, and camera-consistent structure, while the prompt specifies appearance-level information such as smoke density, flame visibility, vegetation type, and wind-driven motion. The prompt is synthesized from simulation metadata and then refined by a VLM (see Appendix F for details). We also use parameter-conditioned negative prompts to suppress conflicting attributes, such as strong wind for low-wind cases or still smoke for high-wind cases. Each generated video retains its originating simulator labels. Its observable cues reflect both the proxy controls and metadata-conditioned prompts; cue agreement is assessed rather than assumed.
paragraphs.zh: 代理渲染编码了模拟器的结构，但视觉效果仍然简单。 我们使用可控的视频生成技术，将其转化为视觉上更丰富的野火片段。 遵循 VACE Jiang 等人 (2025) 的方法，生成器以深度序列 Ranftl 等人 (2020)；Yang 等人 (2024) 为条件，以及草图序列 Chan 等人 (2022) 和文本提示作为输入。 深度和草图控制引导了几何结构、植被布局、火线位置以及与相机一致的结构，而提示则指定了外观层面的信息，例如烟雾密度、火焰可见性、植被类型和风驱动的运动。 提示由模拟元数据合成，随后通过 VLM 进行优化（详见附录 F）。 我们还使用参数化的负向提示来抑制冲突的属性，例如在低风速情况下加入强风设定，或在高风速情况下加入静止烟雾设定。 每个生成的视频都保留了其原始模拟器的标签。 其可观察的线索既反映了代理控制信息，也体现了元数据条件化的提示；我们评估这些线索的一致性，而非简单假设它们一致。

paragraphs.en: The second stage uses the generated video episodes as physics-labeled visual memory for wildfire state estimation and reporting. The design goal is to keep the system training-free: new simulator episodes update the memory bank, not the VLM weights. As shown in Figure 3 , given a query wildfire video, the system retrieves visually and semantically similar memory episodes, uses their simulator labels as reference priors, and combines these priors with direct visual reasoning in a multi-agent report.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段将生成的视频片段用作带有物理标签的视觉记忆，用于野火状态估计和报告。 设计目标是保持系统无需训练：新的模拟器片段会更新记忆库，而非 VLM 权重。 如图 3 所示，给定一个查询的野火视频，系统会检索在视觉和语义上相似的记忆片段，将其模拟器标签用作参考先验，并将这些先验与直接的视觉推理相结合，生成多智能体报告。

paragraphs.en: Each memory entry is a key–value item. The key is a multimodal embedding of the generated wildfire video and its simulation-derived text description. The value stores the generated video, the prompt used to produce it, the 2D simulation parameters, the environmental tags, and downstream fire-behavior labels. This structure makes the memory both searchable and interpretable: retrieval returns not only similar videos, but also the simulator conditions associated with those reference episodes, not ground-truth measurements of the query.
paragraphs.zh: 每个记忆条目都是一个键值对。 键是生成的野火视频及其通过模拟获得的文本描述的多模态嵌入。 值存储了生成的视频、用于生成该视频的提示词、二维模拟参数、环境标签以及下游的火行为标签。 这种结构使记忆既具备可搜索性，又具备可解释性：检索不仅会返回相似的视频，还会返回与这些参考事件相关的模拟器条件，而非查询的真实测量数据。

paragraphs.en: At query time, the same multimodal embedder maps the input video into the shared embedding space. We compute cosine similarity between the query embedding and each memory key and retrieve the top- k k candidate episodes. The retrieved examples are then used as in-context evidence for estimating the query’s wind, moisture, slope, and vegetation tags. In practice (see Section 5.2 ), neither the agent alone nor the embedder alone yields sufficiently accurate classification across these attributes. We therefore complement embedding-based retrieval with candidate reranking before using retrieved labels for query estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 在查询时，相同的多模态嵌入器将输入视频映射到共享的嵌入空间中。 我们计算查询嵌入与每个记忆键之间的余弦相似度，并检索出前 k 个候选片段。 随后，将检索到的示例用作上下文证据，以估计查询的风、湿度、坡度和植被标签。 在实际应用中（参见第 5.2 节），单独使用智能体或嵌入器都无法在这些属性上实现足够准确的分类。 因此，在使用检索到的标签进行查询估计之前，我们用候选重排序来补充基于嵌入的检索方法。

paragraphs.en: We formulate downstream wildfire understanding as an agentic VLM reporting problem combining query observations with retrieved physics-labeled references. Given a query video, the system produces a structured report over fire-behavior fields such as spread risk, burn extent, vegetation condition, and severe-fire indicators. Rather than relying on a single model, we separate report generation into four stages: memory retrieval, multi-agent reporting, disagreement adjudication, and report rendering Lewis et al. (2020) ; Wu et al. (2024a) ; Chan et al. (2023) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将下游野火理解问题构建为一个智能体式 VLM 报告生成问题，该问题将查询观测结果与检索到的带有物理标签的参考信息相结合。 给定一个查询视频，系统会生成一份关于火场行为的结构化报告，涵盖火势蔓延风险、燃烧范围、植被状况和严重火灾指标等字段。 我们并未依赖单一模型，而是将报告生成过程分为四个阶段：记忆检索、多智能体报告生成、意见分歧裁决以及报告渲染 Lewis et al. (2020) ; Wu et al. (2024a) ; Chan et al. (2023) 。

This consensus summarizes the label favored by similar memory episodes and their score-weighted agreement; it is a reference prior rather than a calibrated probability for the query.

paragraphs.en: The reporting stage uses three agents with complementary evidence. The visual reporter receives only sampled query frames and focuses on directly observable cues. The lookup reporter receives the query frames and a train-derived lookup prior from the top retrieved tag bundle. The combined-memory reporter additionally receives the retrieved episode’s simulator summaries. This decomposition keeps disagreements across evidence sources explicit across the reporting pipeline, in line with multi-agent LLM/VLM workflow designs Wu et al. (2024a) ; Chan et al. (2023) .
paragraphs.zh: 报告阶段使用三个具有互补证据的智能体。 视觉报告器仅接收采样的查询帧，并专注于直接可观察的线索。 查找报告器接收查询帧以及从顶部检索到的标签束中获得的训练衍生查找先验。 组合记忆报告器还额外接收所检索回放的模拟器摘要。 这种分解使不同证据来源之间的分歧在整个报告流程中保持明确，这与多智能体 LLM/VLM 工作流程设计 Wu et al. (2024a) ; Chan et al. (2023) 一致。

paragraphs.en: We analyze the main design choices behind the simulation-grounded VLM framework: the embedding model used for retrieval, the reranking step, the need for video memory rather than text-only memory, and the contribution of each reporting agent. Experiments in this section and Sec. 5 use 500 disjoint locations: 400 videos populate the memory bank and 100 videos are held out for evaluation. The distribution of downstream tasks and physics-labels are provided in Appendix A . We also refer readers to provided supplementary materials for more visual examples. Local experiments use an NVIDIA H200 GPU; hosted VLM evaluations use model APIs.

paragraphs.en: To test robustness to changes in the visual synthesis backbone, we replace VACE with LTX-2.3 + AVControl while retaining the simulation and proxy construction, and test both query–memory directions. paragraphs.en: We evaluate real footage using the annotations available in three public UAV datasets: smoke detection on Boreal Forest Fire Pesonen et al. (2025) , binary fire presence on FireMan-UAV-RGBT Kularatne et al. (2024) , and segmentation-derived visible fire-area assessment on FLAME Shamsoshoara et al. (2021) . These tests complement the controlled physical-label experiments by assessing observable aspects of wildfire monitoring. Full results and evaluation descriptions appear in Appendix L .

paragraphs.en: Real-incident environmental-driver estimation still requires validation against synchronized measurements: our real-UAV tests assess smoke/fire detection and visible fire area, whereas physical-label targets come from simulation. The fixed Blender mapping is domain-specific; new simulator fields or scene types may require extending its rules and assets. Spatial correspondence does not make billboard smoke a 3D physical solution or ensure that generated videos preserve proxy dynamics. Metadata-conditioned prompts may introduce tag-specific cues, and footage may omit sensor noise, camera motion, long-horizon evolution, or rare extremes. The coarse simulator and tags omit coupled fire–atmosphere dynamics, spotting, suppression, and changing weather. Retrieval depends on memory coverage, reporter agreement does not guarantee correctness, and reports require expert validation before operational use.
paragraphs.zh: 对真实事件环境驱动因素的估计仍需通过与同步测量数据进行验证：我们的真实无人机测试评估了烟雾/火焰探测和可见火焰区域，而物理标签目标则来自模拟。 固定的 Blender 映射是领域特定的；新的模拟器字段或场景类型可能需要扩展其规则和资产。 空间对应关系并不会使广告牌式烟雾成为三维物理解决方案，也无法确保生成的视频保留代理动态。 基于元数据条件的提示词可能会引入标签特定的线索，而视频素材可能缺少传感器噪声、相机运动、长期演化过程或罕见极端情况。 粗糙的模拟器和标签忽略了火-大气耦合动态、飞火点、灭火过程以及天气变化。 检索结果取决于记忆覆盖范围，报告者的共识并不保证准确性，且报告在投入实际使用前需要专家验证。

paragraphs.en: We presented a simulation-grounded agentic VLM framework for wildfire monitoring and reporting. A fully automatic Blender conversion expresses 2D wildfire states as lightweight, simulation-aligned proxies; controlled video generation produces labeled episodes for multimodal memory. Retrieved references and complementary reporters support environmental-driver estimation and structured reporting without updating VLM weights. Controlled, cross-generator, and real-UAV perceptual tests support this use of simulation experience under scarce physical annotations. Real-world physical calibration and expert validation remain important next steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于模拟的智能体视觉语言模型框架，用于野火监测与报告。 全自动的 Blender 转换可将二维野火状态表示为轻量且与模拟对齐的代理；受控的视频生成则能产出带标签的事件序列，用于多模态记忆。 检索到的参考信息和补充报告支持对环境驱动因素的估算和结构化报告，而无需更新视觉语言模型的权重。 受控、跨生成器以及基于真实无人机的感知测试表明，在物理标注稀缺的情况下，这种对模拟经验的运用是可行的。 现实世界的物理校准与专家验证仍是后续的重要步骤。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate downstream wildfire understanding using six binary report fields. Each field is defined from simulator-derived quantities associated with an episode. Let v max v_{\max} denote the maximum radial spread rate in meters per second, A peak A_{\mathrm{peak}} the maximum burning area during the episode in square meters, A final A_{\mathrm{final}} the final burn-scar area in square meters, and c c the mean canopy-cover percentage. For a held-out query, these quantities define evaluation targets and are withheld from inference. Retrieved memory entries may contain the corresponding quantities for their own reference episodes. The fields describe episode-level conditions and outcomes, not validated operational forecasts. Definitions and label construction follow Section 3.2.2 ; the four environmental-tag thresholds are given in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用六个二元报告字段来评估下游野火理解能力。 每个字段均基于与某一事件相关的、由模拟器推导出的量值进行定义。 令 v max v_{\max} 表示以米/秒为单位的最大径向蔓延速率，A peak A_{\mathrm{peak}} 表示该事件期间的最大燃烧面积（单位：平方米），A final A_{\mathrm{final}} 表示最终的燃烧疤痕面积（单位：平方米），以及 c c 表示平均树冠覆盖百分比。 对于预留的查询，这些量值定义了评估目标，且不会用于推理过程。 检索到的记忆条目可能包含其自身参考事件对应的这些量值。 这些字段描述的是事件层面的条件与结果，而非经过验证的操作性预报。 定义和标签构建遵循第 3.2.2 节；四个环境标签的阈值见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: For completeness, in this section, we list the fire simulation model we used for generating 2D fire simulations together with the definition of the Anderson 13 Fuel Profile with corresponding billboard assets.
paragraphs.zh: 为求完整，在本节中，我们列出了用于生成二维火灾模拟的火灾模拟模型，以及安德森 13 燃料剖面的定义和相应的广告牌资产。

paragraphs.en: For completeness, we provide the Rothermel surface fire spread model used for 2D simulation which is the backend model that SimFire uses. It is a semi-empirical model that predicts the forward rate of spread of a surface fire from local fuel, moisture, wind, and terrain conditions Rothermel (1972) . In our simulations, this model provides a directional rate of spread from an actively burning grid cell to each candidate neighboring cell. All quantities follow the SimFire implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 为求完整，我们提供了用于二维模拟的 Rothermel 地表火蔓延模型，该模型是 SimFire 使用的底层模型。 这是一个半经验模型，通过局部燃料、湿度、风况和地形条件预测地表火的正向蔓延速率（Rothermel, 1972）。 在我们的模拟中，该模型会从一个正在燃烧的网格单元向每个候选的相邻单元提供方向性蔓延速率。 所有物理量均遵循 SimFire 的实现方式。

paragraphs.en: For the 2D simulation stage, we use SimFire Doyle et al. (2024) . All simulations are conducted on a 3 ​ km 3\,\mathrm{km} domain, with each grid cell corresponding to approximately 30 ​ m 30\,\mathrm{m} . The simulation horizon is set to represent one hour of wildfire propagation. For the four major factors affecting the simulations, we define low wind speed as below 3 ​ mph 3\,\mathrm{mph} and high wind speed as above 3 ​ mph 3\,\mathrm{mph} . Low moisture is defined in the range [ 0.0001 , 0.005 ) [0.0001,0.005) , while high moisture is defined in the range [ 0.005 , 0.01 ] [0.005,0.01] . For vegetation coverage and slope, we first query real-world fuel maps and terrain data for each location, and then perform post hoc categorization based on the resulting measurements. Under this procedure, the dataset is approximately divided into low vegetation coverage for values below 6.96 % 6.96\% , and high vegetation coverage for values between 6.96 % 6.96\% and 70.77 % 70.77\% . Similarly, low slope corresponds to values between 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} and 9.10 ∘ 9.10^{\circ} , while high slope corresponds to values between 9.10 ∘ 9.10^{\circ} and 34.94 ∘ 34.94^{\circ} . We additionally show the queried 500 physical locations in Figure 9 .

paragraphs.en: We use Blender to perform proxy 2D-to-3D rendering. For geometry, the elevation fields queried from LANDFIRE are converted into 3D terrain surfaces. For vegetation, following the Anderson 13 fuel model, we collect multiple vegetation and terrain textures and represent different fuel types using billboards. If a grid cell is labeled as burning in the 2D simulation, we randomly sample fire billboards within that cell and additionally render tilted smoke billboards according to the wind speed and wind direction. For camera placement, we choose aerial viewpoints that can observe the initial ignition region while resembling footage captured by a UAV. Finally, all videos are rendered in Blender using the Eevee renderer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Blender 执行代理 2D 转 3D 渲染。 对于几何结构，从 LANDFIRE 查询到的海拔场会被转换为 3D 地形表面。 对于植被，遵循 Anderson 13 燃料模型，我们会收集多种植被和地形纹理，并使用广告牌来表示不同的燃料类型。 如果某个网格单元在 2D 模拟中被标记为燃烧状态，我们就会在该单元内随机采样火灾广告牌，并根据风速和风向额外渲染倾斜的烟雾广告牌。 关于相机位置，我们会选择能够观察到初始点火区域且类似于无人机拍摄画面的空中视角。 最后，所有视频都在 Blender 中使用 Eevee 渲染器进行渲染。

paragraphs.en: Here, we quantitatively assess whether the VACE generation pipeline follows the provided proxy render. We evaluate this by testing whether the generated video is more consistent with its paired render than with a mismatched render. The evaluation metrics are summarized in Table 11 , and the corresponding results are reported in Table 12 . paragraphs.en: We also compare two image-space directional cues between generated and proxy videos. Smoke plume axis Smoke-colored pixels are extracted in each sampled frame. We then use PCA to give the dominant plume axis. Axes are averaged over frames and compared as undirected axes. Growth-front fire-spread axis Flame pixels from the first third of the clip are unioned into an early-fire mask. Flame pixels from the last third are unioned into a late-fire mask. Pixels already near the early mask are removed from the late mask, giving a late-growth region. The vector from the early-fire centroid to the late-growth centroid estimates spread direction. We then compare the generated and rendered videos fire spread axis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还比较了生成视频和代理视频中两种图像空间的方向线索。 烟雾柱轴线：在每个采样帧中提取烟雾颜色的像素。 然后我们使用主成分分析（PCA）来确定主导的烟雾柱轴线。 各帧的轴线会被平均处理，并以无向轴线的形式进行比较。 生长前沿的火势蔓延轴线：将片段前三分之一部分的火焰像素合并为一个早期火点掩膜。 将后三分之一部分的火焰像素合并为一个晚期火点掩膜。 从晚期掩膜中移除已靠近早期掩膜的像素，从而得到晚期生长区域。 从早期火点中心到晚期生长区域中心的向量可估算出蔓延方向。 接着我们比较生成视频和渲染视频中火势蔓延的轴线。

paragraphs.en: We use GPT-5.6-luna to assess agreement between sampled frames from a proxy video and its corresponding conditioned generated video. paragraphs.en: Wind speed and direction are read from simulation metadata. Direction in degrees is converted to one of sixteen compass directions. Wind speed controls the wind-strength phrase, smoke behavior, fire-motion wording, flame-visibility wording, spotting behavior, and the negative prompt. paragraphs.en: We use LTX-2.3 + AVControl as a video-generation backbone independent of the original VACE generator. We evaluate both LTX-generated queries against VACE-generated memory and VACE-generated queries against LTX-generated memory. Results are reported in Table 5 a. Our method reaches 41.00% and 44.44% accuracy, respectively, compared with 28.00% and 27.27% for the strongest direct VLM baselines in the two query sets. This tests changing the video-generation backbone, not changing the physical simulator or procedural proxy renderer. It isolates a visual-generator change from the separate real-UAV tests below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 LTX-2.3 + AVControl 用作视频生成的主干模型，该模型独立于原始的 VACE 生成器。 我们分别评估了 LTX 生成的查询与 VACE 生成的记忆之间的匹配度，以及 VACE 生成的查询与 LTX 生成的记忆之间的匹配度。 结果报告在表 5a 中。 我们的方法在两个查询集上的准确率分别达到了 41.00% 和 44.44%，而最强的直接 VLM 基线模型在这一对数据上的准确率仅为 28.00% 和 27.27%。 这项测试针对的是视频生成主干模型的变化，而非物理模拟器或过程化代理渲染器的变化。 该测试将视觉生成器的变化与下文单独进行的真实无人机测试区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Real wildfire videos jointly annotated with environmental drivers and fire behavior are scarce, motivating the simulation-based construction of labeled reference episodes. We complement the controlled physical-label evaluation with real-UAV tests using available annotations: smoke detection, fire presence, and visible fire-area assessment. These tests assess observable monitoring tasks; the annotations used here do not jointly specify the four environmental drivers needed to validate physical-driver recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 同时标注了环境驱动因素和火灾行为的真实野火视频十分罕见，因此有必要通过模拟来构建带标签的参考片段。 我们利用现有标注（烟雾检测、火灾存在以及可见火区评估）对真实无人机测试进行补充，以完善受控的物理标签评估。 这些测试评估了可观测的监测任务；此处使用的标注并未同时明确验证物理驱动因素恢复所需的四种环境驱动因素。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate binary fire presence on FireMan-UAV-RGBT Kularatne et al. (2024) . Overall accuracy is accompanied by balanced accuracy, which assigns equal weight to fire and no-fire classes in this imbalanced evaluation. Table 24 reports the complete per-method results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 FireMan-UAV-RGBT Kularatne 等人（2024）的研究中评估了二元火灾存在检测的性能。 总体准确率同时伴随着平衡准确率，在这样不平衡的评估中，平衡准确率对火灾和无火灾两类赋予相等的权重。 表 24 报告了每种方法的完整结果。

paragraphs.en: For FLAME Shamsoshoara et al. (2021) , we derive reference visible fire area by summing the fire segmentation regions. In the ranking task, each prompt provides ten videos and asks the model to rank them from the largest to the smallest fire region. Table 25 reports mean AP, largest-fire Hit@1, and fire-area NDCG. Our method has the highest NDCG and ties Claude Sonnet 4.6 on Hit@1; Gemini 2.5 Pro has the highest mean AP. These annotations concern visible fire regions, not a complete physical characterization of fire severity.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 FLAME Shamsoshoara 等人（2021）的研究，我们通过将火焰分割区域相加来推导出参考可见火焰面积。在排序任务中，每个提示提供十个视频，并要求模型按火焰区域从大到小进行排序。表 25 报告了平均 AP、最大火焰 Hit@1 和火焰面积 NDCG。我们的方法获得了最高的 NDCG，并在 Hit@1 上与 Claude Sonnet 4.6 并列；Gemini 2.5 Pro 的平均 AP 最高。这些标注涉及可见的火焰区域，而非对火焰严重程度的完整物理描述。
